description: Racetrack torus, toroidal winding. R=0.10m, r=0.02m, E=0.05m, N=100, I=1A. Each turn is a large closed loop tracing the racetrack centreline at a fixed poloidal offset. Turns distributed evenly around the tube cross-section by poloidal angle.

geometry_interpretation.centreline: racetrack (stadium) in XY plane. Right arc centre (E,0,0)=(0.05,0,0), left arc centre (-E,0,0)=(-0.05,0,0). Arc radius R=0.10m. Straight sections at y=±R=±0.10m, each of length 2E=0.10m.
geometry_interpretation.turn_k_description: Turn k traces the closed racetrack path at a constant radial offset from the centreline. The offset is r*cos(psi_k) in the N_frame direction (outward from the local racetrack centre) and r*sin(psi_k) in the Z-hat direction.
geometry_interpretation.offset_detail_on_arcs: On the right arc (centre (E,0,0)), N_frame = outward radial from (E,0,0). Effective arc radius = R + r*cos(psi_k). On the left arc, same formula relative to (-E,0,0).
geometry_interpretation.offset_detail_on_straights: On top straight (y=R, T_hat=(-1,0,0)), N_frame=(0,1,0). Turn k runs at y = R + r*cos(psi_k). On bottom straight (y=-R, T_hat=(+1,0,0)), N_frame=(0,-1,0). Turn k runs at y = -(R + r*cos(psi_k)).
racetrack_sections_ccw: Section 1: left arc, centre (-E,0,0), N_frame = outward from (-E,0,0)
Section 3: right arc, centre (E,0,0), N_frame = outward from (E,0,0)

winding_mode_interpretation.description: Each turn k is a closed loop tracing the racetrack centreline at poloidal offset psi_k = 2*pi*k/N. Turn k runs at (r*cos(psi_k)) outward and (r*sin(psi_k)) vertically relative to the centreline.
winding_mode_interpretation.per_turn_wire_length_approx: L_cl = 2*pi*R + 4*E = 0.82832 m (to first order, same for all turns)
winding_mode_interpretation.per_turn_wire_length_exact: Exact length varies slightly by psi_k. On arcs: effective radius = R + r*cos(psi_k), so arc contribution is pi*(R + r*cos(psi_k)) per arc, vs pi*R for centreline. On straights: no change. Correction term: 2*pi*r*cos(psi_k).
winding_mode_interpretation.per_turn_wire_length_note: Full exact length: L_cl + 2*pi*r*cos(psi_k). Average over N turns = L_cl (since mean of cos(psi_k) = 0).

discretisation_interpretation.path_k_description: Closed racetrack loop offset by (r*cos(psi_k), 0) outward and (0, 0, r*sin(psi_k)) vertically from the centreline. Parameterised by arc-length position s around the racetrack.
discretisation_interpretation.path_k_parametric: p_k(s) = centreline(s) + r*cos(psi_k)*N_frame(s) + r*sin(psi_k)*Z_hat,  s in [0, L_cl)

checks.note: psi_0=0: outward offset = r*cos(0) = r = 0.02m. Top straight runs at y = R + r = 0.10 + 0.02 = 0.12m.
psi_0=0: on the right arc (centre (E,0)), effective radius = R + r*cos(0) = 0.10 + 0.02 = 0.12m.
psi_25=pi/2: outward offset=r*cos(pi/2)=0, vertical offset=r*sin(pi/2)=r=0.02m. Top straight at y=R=0.10m, z=0.02m.
psi_50=pi: on the right arc, effective radius = R + r*cos(pi) = 0.10 - 0.02 = 0.08m (innermost layer).
